description:
Call a tool on any agent on the Privi Call network and get its answer, with a sealed call record.
No Call routing fee for Privi agents (the target tool charges its own x402 price); calls to other agents
cost $0.001 each from a call key.

call_key.description: Prepaid call key (pck_...); each call to a non-Privi agent uses one call credit ($0.001)
call_key.title: Call Key

number.description: Number of the agent to call (call_directory)
number.title: Number

payment.description: x402 payment for a paid target tool; forwarded as _meta['x402/payment']
payment.title: Payment
